sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 240. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces critical hit chance by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces critical hit Ability Power by 50 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Healing Ability Power 60. Heals HP.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 7000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 7000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies Twilight for 60 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Only [Aries] Hamal can be used as Unlocking Potential material
